# Design System Master File — VN Commerce Kit

> **LOGIC:** When building a specific page, first check `design-system/vn-commerce-kit/pages/[page-name].md`.
> If that file exists, its rules **override** this Master file. If not, strictly follow the rules below.
> Motion rules and the interaction catalogue live in `docs/13-ux-design-and-motion.md` (§4–§5).

**Project:** VN Commerce Kit · **Category:** E-commerce (general / lifestyle retail, VN market)
**Generated by:** ui-ux-pro-max v2 `--design-system` (query "e-commerce retail fashion modern", dials variance 6 / motion 7 / density 5)
**Curated:** 2026-09-29 — deviations from the generated output are listed in §0 and are authoritative.
**Regenerate:** never with `--force` unless the tech lead approves (ADR-013); client brands override via `brand.css` (§8).

---

## 0. Curated deviations from generator output
| Generated | Curated | Why |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Heading font Rubik | **Be Vietnam Pro** | Rubik has no `vietnamese` subset in the skill's own google-fonts catalogue → broken diacritics |
| Body font Nunito Sans | **Be Vietnam Pro** (body) + Noto Sans fallback | One family = fewer font bytes; skill's "Vietnamese Friendly" pairing |
| Page pattern "Feature-Rich Showcase" | **Commerce Home** (pages/home.md) | Generated pattern is SaaS-oriented (features/CTA); stores sell through products, deals and trust |
| Background `#ECFDF5` (mint) everywhere | Neutral `#FAFAF9`; mint only as section tint | Tinted page backgrounds shift product photo colours |
| Border `#A7F3D0` | Neutral `#E7E5E4`; mint for selected states | Saturated borders make dense product grids noisy |
| White text on `#059669` (3.77:1) | Primary solid `#047857` with white (5.48:1) | WCAG AA for button text |
| CTA `#EA580C` + black text | CTA `#C2410C` + white (5.18:1); `#EA580C` for badges/surfaces | VN shoppers expect white-on-orange buy buttons; keeps AA |
| `.card` background `#ECFDF5` | `--color-card` `#FFFFFF` | Generated CSS contradicted its own token table |
| `transition: all 200ms` | Explicit properties + motion tokens | Skill's own perf rule: animate transform/opacity only |
| — | Added sale/price/rating/success/warning tokens | Commerce-specific semantics |

Colour never carries meaning alone: sale = colour + strike-through + "-x%"; status badges include text.

**Category tints** (hero band, subcategory tiles, story circles; text uses the paired dark tone, all ≥ 7:1):
`--color-cat-ao` `#ECFDF5`/`#064E3B` · `--color-cat-quan` `#FFF7ED`/`#7C2D12` · `--color-cat-vay` `#FCE7F3`/`#831843` ·
`--color-cat-giay` `#E0F2FE`/`#0C4A6E` · `--color-cat-phukien` `#FEF3C7`/`#78350F` · all-products `#1C1917`/`#FAFAF9`.
Surface dark `#1C1917` is used for the footer, promo tiles and the mobile filter dock.

## 2. Typography
- Family: **Be Vietnam Pro** 400/500/600/700 via `next/font/google` with `subsets: ["vietnamese", "latin"]`, `display: "swap"`; fallback `"Noto Sans", system-ui, sans-serif`.
- Scale (rem, 1.25 ratio): 0.75 caption · 0.875 small · 1 body · 1.125 lead · 1.25 h4 · 1.563 h3 · 1.953 h2 · 2.441 h1 · 3.052 display (desktop only; clamp on mobile).
- Line-height: body 1.6, headings 1.2; letter-spacing headings -0.01em; max line length 72ch.
- Prices: `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, weight 600; format via `formatVnd()` → `259.000 ₫`.
- Headings use `text-wrap: balance` as progressive enhancement only.

## 3. Spacing, radius, elevation
| Token | Value | Usage |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--space-xs/sm/md/lg/xl/2xl/3xl` | 4/8/16/24/32/48/64 px | Standard density (dial 5) |
| `--radius-sm/md/lg/xl/full` | 6/10/14/20/9999 px | Inputs / buttons / cards / sheets / chips |
| `--shadow-sm` | `0 1px 2px rgb(28 25 23 / .06)` | Resting cards |
| `--shadow-md` | `0 6px 16px -4px rgb(28 25 23 / .12)` | Hover cards, sticky bars |
| `--shadow-lg` | `0 16px 40px -8px rgb(28 25 23 / .18)` | Drawers, dialogs |
Container max 1280px; product grid 2 cols (<640) · 3 (≥768) · 4 (≥1024) · 5 (≥1440); gutter 12/16/24px.

## 4. Style
**Base:** Vibrant & Block-based (generator primary) applied to **merchandising surfaces** (hero, category bento,
flash sale, campaign bands) + **clean minimal** product grid, PDP and checkout (content-first, trust).
Secondary from generator: Motion-Driven (see docs/13). Keywords: bold blocks, generous imagery, rounded geometry,
high-contrast CTAs, calm checkout. Icons: Lucide (SVG), 1.5px stroke, 20/24px; never emoji as icons.

## 5. Component specs (tokens only — no raw hex in components)
- **Button**: height 44px (min touch), padding 0 20px, radius md, weight 600; variants `cta`, `primary`, `outline`,
  `ghost`, `destructive`; loading keeps width, shows spinner, `aria-busy`; press = `scale(.97)` 100ms.
- **Product card**: card bg, radius lg, image 4:5 `object-cover`, second image on hover (desktop), badges top-left
  (sale, new, low stock), wishlist top-right (44px hit area), title 2 lines clamp with full title in `title`/aria,
  price row (sale + original struck), rating row, quick-add on hover (desktop) / "+" button (mobile).
- **Input/Select/Combobox**: height 44px, radius md, border token, focus ring token, label always visible, error text
  below field with icon + `aria-describedby`.
- **Chip (filter)**: radius full, 36px height (44px hit area via padding), selected = primary tint + primary text + check icon.
- **Drawer (cart, filters, menu)**: right (cart) / bottom (mobile filters) / left (menu), radius xl on free edge,
  focus trap, `Esc` closes, returns focus to trigger.
- **Badge**: text + colour; sale badge white text on `--color-price-sale`.
- **Toast**: bottom-center mobile, bottom-right desktop, `role="status"`, auto-dismiss 4s (paused on hover/focus), undo action for removals.
- **Skeleton**: muted bg, same box as final content (CLS 0), shimmer per docs/13.
- **Footer (global)**: dark surface; desktop 4 columns (brand + business info [name, tax id, address, hotline] +
  socials incl. Zalo OA | Hỗ trợ | Về chúng tôi | payment & shipping logos) and a bottom bar (© + MOIT
  "Đã thông báo Bộ Công Thương" badge slot); mobile uses `<details>` accordions + logo chips. Links ≥ 32px tall
  desktop, ≥ 40px mobile. Omitted on checkout steps (pages/checkout.md) and in the admin.
- **Page shell / sticky footer**: the page root is a flex column with `min-height: 100dvh`; the footer takes
  `margin-top: auto` preceded by a fixed spacer (88px desktop, 40px mobile) so it sits at the viewport bottom on
  short pages (empty search, auth) and after content on long ones. In scroll containers (mobile sheets/panels) the
  same rule applies with `flex-shrink: 0` on children. Never `position: fixed` for the footer.
- **Popover (filter/sort)**: anchored below its pill, radius lg, shadow-lg, 280px min width, closes on outside click,
  `Esc` and selection (single-choice), keeps focus inside while open.

## 6. Accessibility & quality (from generator checklist + project rules)
- [ ] Text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 (large ≥ 3:1); focus visible on every interactive element
- [ ] Touch targets ≥ 44×44px, ≥ 8px apart
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` respected (docs/13 §4.4)
- [ ] Responsive at 375, 768, 1024, 1440; no horizontal scroll; zoom not disabled
- [ ] `cursor-pointer` on clickable elements; hover never the only way to reach an action
- [ ] Vietnamese text reflows without clipping (long product names, chips, badges)
- [ ] Images WebP/AVIF, explicit sizes, CLS < 0.1; LCP image not animated

## 7. Admin dashboard
Medusa admin uses `@medusajs/ui`. Admin widgets/routes follow Medusa UI tokens and components, **not** this palette,
so the dashboard stays coherent. From the generator's admin run (density 8, motion 3): dense tables, minimal motion
(≤ 160ms fades), charts per `--domain chart` (bar for revenue trend by day/week, share bars for top products, no pie for
> 5 slices). Structure, states and permission behaviour for every admin screen: `pages/admin.md`.

## 8. Rebranding for client projects
All colours/radii/fonts are CSS variables in `packages/ui-kit/src/tokens.css`; a client brand ships `brand.css`
overriding only variables, plus a page override file if layout differs. Re-run the generator for the client's product
type to get candidates, then curate (§0 table) — never paste generator output unreviewed.
